name: Hindustan Unilever Ltd
tagline: Mega-cap FMCG compounder with best-in-class ROCE/ROE but structurally slow growth - no confirmed named inflection this pass, so it stays a fast-track 'neither' regardless of quality.
business_overview: Hindustan Unilever (NSE/BSE: HINDUNILVR) is India's largest FMCG company, spanning Home Care, Beauty & Personal Care, and Foods & Refreshment, with a portfolio of 50+ brands across 16 categories (Lux, Surf Excel, Dove, Lifebuoy, Horlicks/foods, etc.), majority-owned by Unilever plc.
fundamentals_narrative: HUL remains a best-in-class quality business by capital returns (ROCE ~28%, ROE ~31%, debt-free) but revenue growth has been structurally slow (~6.5% over five years) as FMCG volume growth in India has been muted and rural demand recovery has been gradual. At ~41x trailing P/E, the stock already prices in quality and stability rather than acceleration.
technical_read: Trading near the lower half of its 52-week range (~Rs 1,926-2,553), close to the 52-week low - not pulled in further TA detail this pass.
